title: Add a unity-mcp operator skill adapted from the upstream MCP for Unity skills
description:
## Summary
Adapt the upstream MCP for Unity skill set (`CoplayDev/unity-mcp`, `.claude/skills`) into this repository so agents can operate Unity correctly through MCP.

## User Mandate
> "Review the unity mcp skills in this repo [unity-mcp/.claude/skills at beta · CoplayDev/unity-mcp · GitHub](https://github.com/CoplayDev/unity-mcp/tree/beta/.claude/skills) and ensure we have the correct skills here too for interacting with unity via mcp"

STRICT. Binding constraints:
- Review the upstream skill set before writing anything.
- Ensure this repository has equivalent, correct skills for MCP-driven Unity work.
- Do not introduce skill content that misstates this workspace's tool surface.

## Scope
- Added `.github/skills/unity-mcp-operator/SKILL.md` and `references/mcp-surface.md`.
- Wired the skill into the `.github/agents/BeastMaster.agent.md` graduated discovery list.
- Upstream `blender-to-unity` assessed not applicable: no Blender MCP is connected and CreatureCreator derives meshes from DNA.
- Upstream `mcp-source` captured as the package-source section of `references/mcp-surface.md` instead of a separate skill.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A discoverable skill owns MCP call mechanics: readiness, resources, tool groups, batching, payload and pagination limits, console checks, screenshots, and error recovery.
- Frontmatter is valid and the `name` matches the folder.
- The skill cross-links `unity-validation` and does not duplicate its evidence policy.
- Tool and resource names match the live workspace surface, or are explicitly marked version-dependent.
- The agent discovery list references the new skill.

## Validation
- 2026-09-12: `get_errors` clean on `SKILL.md`, `references/mcp-surface.md`, and `BeastMaster.agent.md` after aligning table separators with the repo convention.
- 2026-09-12: link targets exist: `.github/skills/unity-validation/SKILL.md`, `Assets/Scripts/README.md`, `docs/tasks/handoffs/2026-08-24-cc049-limb-blend-and-next-steps-handoff.md`, `Packages/manifest.json`.
- 2026-09-12 live MCP evidence: console banner `MCP-FOR-UNITY: StdioBridgeHost started on port 6401. (OS=WindowsEditor, server=10.1.2)`; `manage_script_capabilities` returned structured ops, text ops, `max_edit_payload_bytes` 262144, `using_guard` true, `get_sha` true.
- No Unity runtime behavior changed, so no test run was required.

## Findings
- This workspace reaches gated tool groups through `activate_*_tools` bridge tools; the upstream guide documents the older `manage_tools(action="activate", group=...)` form. Recorded as drift rather than copied verbatim.
- Repo-specific MCP mechanics (runtime test assembly not discovered by the runner, `batch_execute` key-order flake, `execute_code` group reset after domain reload) existed only in handoff narrative before this change.

## Blockers
None.

## Next Step
Add a dedicated `mcp-source` skill only if package-source switching becomes routine.

comments.body:
Implementation evidence (2026-09-12)

Files added/changed:
- `.github/skills/unity-mcp-operator/SKILL.md` (new) — readiness gate, resource-first loop, tool groups, batch/payload discipline, pagination, screenshots, console gating, multi-instance routing, error-recovery table, repo gotchas, boundaries, completion criteria.
- `.github/skills/unity-mcp-operator/references/mcp-surface.md` (new) — resource URIs, activation map, directly available tools, `manage_script_capabilities` snapshot, payload/paging rules, upstream drift note, package-source note.
- `.github/agents/BeastMaster.agent.md` — added the `unity-mcp-operator` bullet to graduated discovery.

Upstream review outcome (3 skills in `CoplayDev/unity-mcp/.claude/skills`):
- `unity-mcp-skill` — adapted. Upstream text is template-based and documents `manage_tools(...)` plus direct `manage_gameobject`/`manage_components`/`manage_camera`/`manage_ui`/`manage_packages`/`run_tests`; this workspace gates those behind `activate_*_tools`. Recorded as drift instead of copying.
- `blender-to-unity` — not applicable. No Blender MCP tools are connected in this session and CreatureCreator meshes are procedural DNA outputs, not external model imports. No skill created; no scope silently dropped without note.
- `mcp-source` — reduced to a package-source section in the reference file, since `Packages/manifest.json` pins `com.coplaydev.unity-mcp` to `...#main` and switching is a rare maintenance action. A full skill is deferred, not lost.

Checks run:
- `get_errors`: clean on all three files after switching to spaced table separators (repo convention, markdownlint MD060).
- Path checks: `.github/skills/unity-validation/SKILL.md`, `Assets/Scripts/README.md`, `docs/tasks/handoffs/2026-08-24-cc049-limb-blend-and-next-steps-handoff.md`, `Packages/manifest.json` all resolve.
- Live MCP: console banner reports `server=10.1.2`; `manage_script_capabilities` confirms the structured/text op sets and limits documented in the reference.

Residual risk: the activation map is a snapshot of one session on MCP server 10.1.2. The reference file states this and points readers at the live tool list.
